elements.note: Openings are numbered in two different symbol shapes. Per the A-01 legend a CIRCLE is a door number and a pentagon/hexagon is a window number, but at 1:100 the two outlines are hard to separate reliably, so the marks are recorded by the shape actually seen rather than being asserted as doors or windows. Circles seen carry 1, 3, 4, 5, 6; hexagons carry 2 and 3. Resolve against the door schedule on A-22 and the window schedule on A-23 before use.

elements.note: The right-hand chain (1.90 / 3.00 / 1.70 / 1.30 / 0.70) sets out the kitchen, laundry and car-port walls, none of which land on grid lines.

warnings: GROUND-FLOOR PLAN. Note the two titles disagree slightly: the title block says 'แปลนพื้นชั้น 1' and the drawing title under the plan says 'แปลนพื้นชั้นล่าง'. Same plan.

*** ROOM TAGS ARE THREE-PART AND DECODE AGAINST A-01. *** Each tag reads [floor-finish no.] +level (ceiling no.), e.g. ห้องนอน 1 = '1 +0.40 (1)' -> vinyl tile floor, +0.40 m, standard gypsum ceiling. All eleven room tags are recorded that way rather than as a single string, so they join straight onto the A-01 material list.

FINISH PATTERN ACROSS THE FLOOR: the living rooms are all 1/1 (vinyl over gypsum); the bathroom alone is 2/2 (matt ceramic over moisture-resistant gypsum); kitchen, laundry, terrace and car port use floor 3 or 5 with ceiling 3; and the under-stair store is 5/5 -- bare power-floated concrete both ways.
LEVELS REPEAT THE A-04 LADDER: +0.40 through the house, +0.38 in the wet areas and on the terrace, +0.25 and +0.10 on the entrance steps, +0.10 at the car port, +0.00 at the drive.

SIX DETAIL CROSS-REFERENCES ARE CALLED OUT and all resolve within the architectural set: WC1 -> A-24, ST-1 -> A-16, ST-2 and the ramp -> A-18, railing 2 -> A-21, column base -> A-17. None of them dangle.

OPENING NUMBERS COULD NOT BE SPLIT INTO DOORS AND WINDOWS WITH CONFIDENCE. Two symbol outlines are in use -- circles carrying 1/3/4/5/6 and pentagon-or-hexagons carrying 2/3 -- and the A-01 legend says circle = door, pentagon = window, but at 1:100 the two outlines are not reliably distinguishable. They are recorded by observed shape and flagged door_vs_window_shape_assignment_inferred; A-22 and A-23 carry the real schedules.
WALL FINISHES USE PAIRED TRIANGLES, one pointing at each face, so a wall can be tagged differently inside and out. Nearly everything is 1/1; the bathroom shows 2 on the wet face.
The 2.40 / 0.20 / 2.40 sub-chain in bay 2-3 is the SAME chain that locates the off-grid B5 beam on structural sheet S-04 -- architectural and structural agree on the stair-well width.
